page.overview:
What is Eugenia Jenkins?

Minister Eugenia Jenkins was a British witch who served as the twenty-ninth Minister for Magic of the British Ministry of Magic, in office from 1968 to 1975.

She dealt competently with the pure-blood riots during the Squib Rights marches in the late sixties. However, when confronted with the first rise of Lord Voldemort, she was ousted from office, being deemed inadequate to the challenge.
